
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/halfcode/p/22340972" title="发布于 2026-08-08 19:46">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">8. 一键出报告，结果填入HTML模板</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>配套动画视频在<a href="https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1U7G36CE81/" rel="noopener nofollow">《8. 一键出报告：结果填入HTML模板》</a>，源代码在<a href="https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1U7G36CE81/" rel="noopener nofollow">《评论区置顶》</a>。</p>
<p>截图有了，还差一份能打开看的测试报告。这一节把结果填进 HTML 模板：先声明工具入参，再把输出路径和截图路径规范到工程内；有 test_results.json 就读并合并用例截图，没有则从文本里解析总计/通过/失败。接着用 Jinja2 把结果填进 templates/</p>
<p>report_template.html，写出能本地打开的网页，并返回通过率；任一步异常则返回错误信息。</p>
<p><img alt="[图片]" class="eva3-bili-image lazyload" data-eva3-scoped="" data-size="105.85" data-width="1260" data-height="892" data-url="http://i0.hdslb.com/bfs/new_dyn/98553611e94602319687ae262c6a973e3546912993053582.png" data-ai-gen-pic="0" data-eva-image="enhanced" data-pm-slice="0 0 []" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1919157/202608/1919157-20260808194642735-434687096.png"></p>
<p>模板要用到 Jinja2，提前装好即可：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>pip install Jinja2</pre>
</div>
<p>先定义工具入参：test_output 是结果文本，output_path 是报告保存路径，screenshots 是截图路径列表。调用时要把截图路径传进来，否则报告里看不到图。工具名是 generate_test_report，Agent 按这个名字调用：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> GenerateReportInput(BaseModel):
    test_output: str </span>= Field(description=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">测试输出结果</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    screenshots: list </span>= Field(default_factory=list, description=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">截图路径列表</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    output_path: str </span>= Field(description=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">报告保存路径</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> GenerateReportTool(BaseTool):
    name: str </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">generate_test_report</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    description: str </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">根据测试结果生成HTML测试报告</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    args_schema: Type[BaseModel] </span>= GenerateReportInput</pre>
</div>
<p>_run 里先做路径规范化。传入的路径可能是 /testcases/...，也可能是相对路径。用 _resolve 统一成工程根目录下的绝对路径，截图列表里每一项同样处理。screenshots 为 None 时按空列表处理。整个 _run 包在 try/except 里，任一步异常都返回错误信息：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> _run(self, test_output: str, output_path: str, screenshots: list = None) -&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> str:
    base_dir </span>= os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">__file__</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">))
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _resolve(path):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> path.startswith(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">):
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> os.path.normpath(os.path.join(base_dir, path.lstrip(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)))
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> path <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> os.path.isabs(path) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> os.path.normpath(
            os.path.join(base_dir, path))
    output_path </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _resolve(output_path)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> screenshots <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">is</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> None:
        screenshots </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> []
    screenshots </span>= [_resolve(s) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> s <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> screenshots]</pre>
</div>
<p>取数时优先看 testcases/test_results.json。有就 json.load，并把每个用例 screenshots 里的 path 合并进截图列表。没有 JSON，就调用 _parse_output 从 test_output 文本里解析总计、通过和失败：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>results_file = os.path.join(base_dir, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">testcases</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">test_results.json</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> os.path.exists(results_file):
    with open(results_file, </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">r</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, encoding=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">utf-8</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) as f:
        test_results </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> json.load(f)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> tc <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> test_results.get(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">test_cases</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, []):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> s <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> tc.get(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">screenshots</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, []):
            p </span>= s.get(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">path</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> isinstance(s, dict) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> s
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> p <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">and</span> p <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">not</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> screenshots:
                screenshots.append(p)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
    test_results </span>= self._parse_output(test_output)</pre>
</div>
<p>渲染阶段根据 passed/total 算通过率 rate；把外部传入的 screenshots 与各用例内截图去重合并成 all_shots；用 FileSystemLoader 加载 templates/report_template.html，把 results、rate、type_labels、all_shots、report_dir 和 to_relative_path 传给模板。to_relative_path 把截图绝对路径转成相对报告文件的路径，并把反斜杠换成 /，本地打开 HTML 时图片才能显示：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>report_dir =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(output_path))
rate </span>= (results[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">passed</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>] / results[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">total</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>] * 100) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> results[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">total</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>] &gt; 0 <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 0
type_labels </span>= {<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">before</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">测试前</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">after</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">测试后</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
               </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">failed</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">失败时</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">error</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">错误时</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">step</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">步骤截图</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}
all_shots </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> []
seen </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> set()
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> s <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> screenshots:
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> s <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">not</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> seen:
        all_shots.append(s)
        seen.add(s)

template_dir </span>= os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">__file__</span>)), <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">templates</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
env </span>= Environment(loader=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">FileSystemLoader(template_dir))
template </span>= env.get_template(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">report_template.html</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> to_relative_path(abs_path: str, base_dir: str) -&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> str:
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
        rel </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> os.path.relpath(abs_path, base_dir)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> rel.replace(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\\</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">except</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Exception:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> abs_path.replace(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\\</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

html </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> template.render(
    results</span>=results, rate=rate, type_labels=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">type_labels,
    all_shots</span>=all_shots, report_dir=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">report_dir,
    to_relative_path</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">to_relative_path)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> html</pre>
</div>
<p>最后调用 _build_html 得到完整 HTML 字符串，确保输出目录存在，再写入 output_path。返回值带上总计、通过、失败和通过率；中间抛异常时返回「生成报告失败：…」：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>html =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self._build_html(test_results, screenshots, output_path)
output_file </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Path(output_path)

    f.write(html)
total </span>= test_results.get(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">total</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, 0)
passed </span>= test_results.get(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">passed</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, 0)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">报告生成成功：{output_path}\n总计:{total} 通过:{passed} </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

</div>
<p>要把启停截图和出报告串起来，可以用 open_app_screenshot_close_report：先调用 open_app_screenshot_close 拿到 shot_path；再拼一份单用例结构的 test_results 写入 test_results.json；最后调用 GenerateReportTool._run，screenshots 参数带上 [shot_path]，报告页面里才会有这张图：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>shot_path =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> open_app_screenshot_close(screenshot_path)
passed </span>= 1 <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> shot_path <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 0
failed </span>= 0 <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> shot_path <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span> 1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

    case_shots.append({</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">type</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">step</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">label</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">app_screenshot</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                       </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">path</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: shot_path})

test_results </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">total</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>: 1, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">passed</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>: passed, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">failed</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: failed,

        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">case_id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">TC_OPEN_SHOT_CLOSE</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">case_name</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">启动App截图关闭</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">status</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">passed</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> shot_path <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">failed</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">screenshots</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: case_shots,
    }],
}
with open(results_file, </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">w</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, encoding=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">utf-8</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) as f:
    json.dump(test_results, f, ensure_ascii</span>=False, indent=2<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

shot_list </span>= [shot_path] <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> shot_path <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> []
report_msg </span>= GenerateReportTool()._run(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">''</span>, report_path, shot_list)</pre>
</div>
<p>这样，从启停截图到 HTML 报告就接上了：本地打开报告文件，就能看到通过率和对应截图。</p>
<p>配套动画视频在<a href="https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1U7G36CE81/" rel="noopener nofollow">《8. 一键出报告：结果填入HTML模板》</a>，源代码在<a href="https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1U7G36CE81/" rel="noopener nofollow">《评论区置顶》</a>。</p>
